message: The request of POST /plants (named after its request body schema components.schemas.NewPlant, which Fern inlines into the request) is named "NewPlant", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.Seedling (named by its x-fern-type-name) at #/components/schemas/Seedling/x-fern-type-name. fern check fails with "NewPlant is already declared". Rename this request with x-fern-request-name on the operation.
